body:
## Owner request — October 14

> With the RVZ files, there's something we also need to adapt in RA offline proxy. We should look at that. In addition, this should already be an instruction file: we want to make sure that we're always looking for where we have a chance to submit upstream fixes.

## Current scope

#574 establishes an EmulationStation RVZ recognition/hash-reader gap. That does not establish whether RAOfflineProxy independently reads/hashes the same files, consumes ES metadata, filters RVZ or GameCube entries, or supports the resulting offline path. Trace the pinned proxy plus every local patch and current upstream before selecting an adaptation. Preserve existing offline functionality. Do not treat Dolphin's in-game achievements as proxy qualification.

D-WORKFLOW-162 already requires early upstream issue/release/fix research. Extend the existing engineering rule to require an explicit contribution disposition for fixes: component owner, minimal independent patch, existing upstream match, and public reproducible evidence. Preparing a contribution is distinct from submitting it.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes: synthetic ROM/metadata/cache fixtures can test discovery, hash handoff and preparation without owner ROMs, accounts or award submissions. Source-only investigation first; runtime needs a bounded allocation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Source report binds the exact proxy pin/local patches and current upstream comparison; identifies the RVZ discovery/hash/cache path and any actual missing adaptation.
- [ ] A minimal repair, or evidence that none is needed, has synthetic VM regression proof for recognized RVZ and malformed/unsupported cases without changing existing offline behavior.
- [ ] #574's combined frontend/proxy qualification explicitly references that evidence and retains any remaining Dolphin gameplay limitation.
- [ ] Canonical engineering instructions require consideration of upstream contributions; decision and rule checks pass.
- [ ] Each independently useful fix records its upstream target and minimal patch/test requirements; later submission is linked, or duplicate/already-fixed/fork-specific disposition is explicit.

Related #574, #573, #570 and #581. This precedes combined M7 candidate qualification; it grants no device/cloud/account actions or upstream publication.
title: M7.P5: Verify RVZ offline proxy support and upstream fix routing
